items.description: An auto mechanic recovered unpaid overtime and missed meal and rest break premiums after being required to work through breaks during busy shifts.
A restaurant server recovered unpaid wages after a tip pooling arrangement improperly diverted tips to non-tipped employees.
A bartender was terminated shortly after reporting a scheduling dispute to management, with the employer's stated reason failing to match the documented timeline.
A medical professional was terminated after requesting a medical leave accommodation, in violation of California's job-protected leave laws.
A software engineer misclassified as an independent contractor recovered unpaid overtime and benefits after being reclassified as an employee.
A departing executive's severance offer was renegotiated after review revealed the release language was broader than legally required.
